Suffered me by th, voice of slaves, To be whooped out of Rome. Now this extremity hath brought me to thy hearth, Not out of hope, mistake me not, to save my life. For if I had feared death of all the men I th, world I would have voided thee, But in mere spite to be full quit of those my banishers, Stand I before thee here. Speed thee straight, and make my misery serve thy turn. But if so be thou darst not this, And that to prove more fortunes thou, art he tired, Then in a word I also am longer to live most weary, And present my throat to thee and to thy ancient malice, Which not to cut would show thee but a fool, Since I have ever followed thee with hate,
